/directory.text: Directory People and groups come from Active Directory, read-only. Sign-in in the browser goes through Entra ID; the Windows share uses the domain join. Active Directory Not set up Set these in the app's environment and restart. Use a read-only service account. AB_LDAP_URL=ldaps://dc01.lab.local AB_LDAP_BIND_DN=CN=svc-buckets,OU=Service,DC=lab,DC=local AB_LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD=… AB_LDAP_BASE_DN=D

/smb.text: SMB shares The same folders, mapped as drives in Windows. Permissions come from the grants in this app and are written to the files, so Explorer shows them as normal NTFS permissions. Re-apply permissions H: home /users/<username> \\buckets.lab.local\home Copy Each person lands in their own folder. Mapped by Group Policy, or by hand with net use H: \\buckets.lab.local\home. S: shared /shared \\b
